scenario.summary: Guest opens the webstore, signs in from the header with a registered account's username and password, checks the 'Hello,' greeting, logs out and checks the Sign In link is back.
steps: Header Sign In; sign in with the account's username and password; greeting visible and contains 'Hello,'
Log out; Sign In link visible again
stateChanges: None in the data: a successful sign-in of the declared account (session only; the account's failed-attempt counter, if any, is reset by the successful sign-in)
assertions: Header greeting visible and contains 'Hello,' after sign-in
Sign In link visible after log out
evidence: Title 'verify sign in functionality' and the step labels (Sign in from the header, Log out) match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec opts out of the shared session (test.use storageState empty) and signs in with loginPage.login(data.username, data.password) read through loadData from login/sign-in.json. Source 1 (keyPath username, masked by key name) and source 2 (keyPath password, masked by key name) are typed into the sign-in form (scan usedBy steps 2/4), so both are real credentials: role credential, alias user. user -> USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred.required true on the username source 1; the migrated test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before signing in (same pattern as the approved quick-order retail and home-page header entries)
